pinyin: guà yáng tóu mài gǒu ròu
literal: hang · sheep · head · sell · dog · meat
natural: Hanging up a sheep's head but selling dog meat

meaning.en: To advertise one thing and sell another; false advertising.
meaning.zh: 比喻用好的名义做幌子，实际上名不副实或做坏事。

equivalents: not what it says on the tin

examples.zh: 这家所谓的健康食品店其实是挂羊头卖狗肉。
examples.en: The so-called health food shop is pure bait and switch.

examples.zh: 有些培训班挂羊头卖狗肉，根本不教真本事。
examples.en: Some training courses are false advertising and teach nothing useful.

usage.en: Predicate. Colloquial; very common in criticism of businesses.

meaning.en: Justice may seem slow but no wrongdoer escapes.
meaning.zh: 天道之网虽然稀疏，但绝不会漏掉坏人。比喻作恶的人终究逃不脱惩罚。

equivalents: the mills of God grind slowly
you can run but you can't hide

examples.zh: 天网恢恢，疏而不漏，逃了十年的嫌犯终于落网。
examples.en: Justice will be done — the suspect who'd been on the run for ten years has finally been caught.

examples.zh: 法网疏而不漏，违法者终将受到惩罚。
examples.en: No lawbreaker escapes the net of the law in the end.

story.en: Laozi: "Heaven's net is vast; though its mesh is wide, nothing slips through" (天网恢恢，疏而不失). The common form today is 疏而不漏.
story.zh: 《老子》："天网恢恢，疏而不失。"后多作"疏而不漏"。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: Almost always in the full saying 天网恢恢，疏而不漏.
usage.zh: 多用全句"天网恢恢，疏而不漏"。

meaning.en: Careless; not paying attention to detail.
meaning.zh: 做事马虎，不细心。

examples.zh: 考试时粗心大意，把加号看成了减号。
examples.en: Being careless in the exam, I misread a plus sign as a minus.

examples.zh: 他做事粗心大意，经常丢东西。
examples.en: He's scatterbrained and always losing things.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Very common, especially about schoolwork.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常用于学习。

natural: Rain pouring as if from a ladle

meaning.en: Torrential rain; pouring down.
meaning.zh: 像用瓢泼水那样的大雨。形容雨很大。

examples.zh: 刚出门就下起了瓢泼大雨。
examples.en: As soon as I went out, it started bucketing down.

examples.zh: 在瓢泼大雨中，救援人员仍在搜救。
examples.en: Rescuers kept searching in the torrential rain.

usage.en: Noun phrase; object of 下起.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，如"下起了瓢泼大雨"。

meaning.en: Nepotism; appointing people because of personal ties rather than merit.
meaning.zh: 任用人只选跟自己关系密切的，而不管德才如何。

examples.zh: 这家公司任人唯亲，有能力的人都走了。
examples.en: The company's cronyism has driven all the able people away.

examples.zh: 选拔干部要任人唯贤，不能任人唯亲。
examples.en: Officials should be chosen on merit, not nepotism.

usage.en: Predicate. Contrasted with 任人唯贤 (appointing on merit).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，与"任人唯贤"相对。

meaning.en: Anxious and apprehensive.
meaning.zh: 形容因害怕或担心而不安。

examples.zh: 他做错了事，整天惴惴不安。
examples.en: Having done something wrong, he was on edge all day.

examples.zh: 市场前景不明，投资者惴惴不安。
examples.en: With the market outlook unclear, investors are apprehensive.

usage.en: Predicate. More literary than 忐忑不安. 惴 is zhuì.

natural: The great task is announced complete

meaning.en: Mission accomplished; a great task is completed.
meaning.zh: 大工程、大任务宣告完成。

examples.zh: 最后一块砖砌好，大功告成！
examples.en: The last brick is laid — job done!

examples.zh: 经过三年努力，大桥终于大功告成。
examples.en: After three years of work, the bridge is finally complete.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，也单独作感叹。

natural: Raising one's brows and breathing freely

meaning.en: To feel proud and elated after being held down; to hold one's head high.
meaning.zh: 形容被压抑的心情得到舒展而高兴痛快。

examples.zh: 球队终于夺冠，球迷们扬眉吐气。
examples.en: The team finally won the title, and the fans could hold their heads high.

examples.zh: 这次考试他考了第一，总算扬眉吐气了。
examples.en: He came top in this exam and was finally vindicated.

story.en: Li Bai, seeking patronage, asked the official Han Chaozong: "Why begrudge a foot of space before your steps, rather than letting me raise my brows and breathe freely, rising to the blue clouds?"
story.zh: 李白《与韩荆州书》："何惜阶前盈尺之地，不使白扬眉吐气，激昂青云耶？"

literal: can · get by · just · get by

meaning.en: To muddle along without ambition; to just get by.
meaning.zh: 只要能过得去就这样过下去。指没有长远打算，也指工作敷衍。

examples.zh: 他对工作得过且过，从不想着进步。
examples.en: He just coasts along at work and never thinks about improving.

examples.zh: 年轻人不能得过且过，要有目标。
examples.en: Young people shouldn't just muddle along — they need goals.

synonyms: 今朝有酒今朝醉，明日愁来明日愁

literal: take advantage of · fire · commit · robbery
natural: Looting while the house is on fire

meaning.en: To take advantage of others' misfortune for one's own gain.
meaning.zh: 趁人家失火时去抢劫。比喻乘人之危谋取私利。

examples.zh: 疫情期间有人趁火打劫，高价卖口罩。
examples.en: During the pandemic some people profiteered by selling masks at huge prices.

examples.zh: 对手公司趁火打劫，挖走了我们的客户。
examples.en: A rival kicked us when we were down and poached our clients.

story.en: One of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: "When the enemy is in trouble, take the opportunity to seize gain" (敌之害大，就势取利).
story.zh: 《三十六计》第五计："敌之害大，就势取利。"

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

meaning.en: Blinded by greed.
meaning.zh: 贪图名利的欲望迷住了心窍。

equivalents: greed got the better of him

examples.zh: 他利欲熏心，挪用了公司的巨款。
examples.en: Blinded by greed, he embezzled huge sums from the company.

examples.zh: 有些商人利欲熏心，卖假药害人。
examples.en: Some traders, blinded by greed, sell fake medicine.

natural: Suiting one's heart and matching one's wishes

meaning.en: Exactly as one wishes; perfectly satisfactory.
meaning.zh: 完全符合心意。

examples.zh: 她终于找到了一份称心如意的工作。
examples.en: She finally found a job that's just what she wanted.

examples.zh: 祝你新年称心如意！
examples.en: May the new year bring you everything you wish for!

usage.en: Attributive or predicate. 称 is chèn (to suit).
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语。"称"读 chèn。

natural: Painting the sounds and the colours

meaning.en: Vivid and lively (of description or storytelling).
meaning.zh: 形容叙述或描写生动逼真。

examples.zh: 爷爷绘声绘色地讲着鬼故事。
examples.en: Grandpa told ghost stories with vivid detail.

examples.zh: 她把旅途见闻讲得绘声绘色。
examples.en: She brought her travels to life in the telling.

usage.en: Adverbial or complement (讲得绘声绘色).

meaning.en: To know when to stop; not to overdo it.
meaning.zh: 到了适当的程度就停下来。

examples.zh: 玩游戏要适可而止。
examples.en: Know when to stop playing games.

examples.zh: 开玩笑也要适可而止，别伤了别人。
examples.en: Don't take jokes too far — you'll hurt someone.

natural: Not letting it pass through one's mind

meaning.en: Careless and indifferent; not paying attention.
meaning.zh: 随随便便，不放在心上。

examples.zh: 他漫不经心地翻着杂志。
examples.en: He flicked through the magazine absent-mindedly.

examples.zh: 对待安全问题绝不能漫不经心。
examples.en: You can never be offhand about safety.

meaning.en: Dazzlingly splendid with gold and colour (of buildings).
meaning.zh: 形容建筑物异常华丽，光彩夺目。

examples.zh: 故宫的宫殿金碧辉煌。
examples.en: The halls of the Forbidden City are resplendent.

examples.zh: 剧院大厅金碧辉煌，令人惊叹。
examples.en: The theatre's foyer is dazzling.

meaning.en: To achieve success and fame.
meaning.zh: 功业建立了，名声也有了。

examples.zh: 他功成名就后回到家乡办学。
examples.en: After making it big, he returned home to found a school.

examples.zh: 不是每个人都能功成名就。
examples.en: Not everyone can achieve fame and fortune.

natural: Covering one's ears to steal a bell

meaning.en: To fool oneself; to bury one's head in the sand.
meaning.zh: 偷铃铛怕别人听见而捂住自己的耳朵。比喻自己欺骗自己。

equivalents: bury one's head in the sand

examples.zh: 把问题藏起来不处理，无异于掩耳盗铃。
examples.en: Hiding a problem instead of dealing with it is just burying your head in the sand.

examples.zh: 删掉差评就以为没人知道，真是掩耳盗铃。
examples.en: Deleting bad reviews and thinking no one will know is pure self-deception.

story.en: A thief tried to steal a big bell but it was too heavy, so he decided to smash it. Afraid the noise would be heard, he covered his own ears.
story.zh: 有人想偷一口大钟，背不动就想砸碎，怕钟声被人听见，竟捂住自己的耳朵。原为"掩耳盗钟"。

usage.en: Predicate or object. Originally a bell (钟), later 铃.

synonyms: 捂着耳朵偷铃铛——自己骗自己
鸵鸟钻沙堆——顾头不顾尾

meaning.en: To become even stronger with added help.
meaning.zh: 好像老虎长上了翅膀。比喻强大的得到援助后更加强大。

examples.zh: 有了这位新外援，球队如虎添翼。
examples.en: With the new foreign signing, the strong team is even stronger.

examples.zh: 新技术的引进让工厂如虎添翼。
examples.en: The new technology has given the factory a real boost.

usage.en: Predicate. For the already strong becoming stronger.

meaning.en: Priceless; extremely valuable.
meaning.zh: 形容物品十分贵重。

examples.zh: 博物馆里珍藏着一件价值连城的青铜器。
examples.en: The museum holds a priceless bronze.

examples.zh: 这幅古画价值连城。
examples.en: This ancient painting is priceless.

story.en: The King of Qin offered fifteen cities in exchange for Zhao's He Shi jade disc — the origin of the idea of a treasure "worth linked cities".
story.zh: 秦王愿以十五城换赵国的和氏璧，后以"价值连城"形容极其贵重。

natural: A light cart on a familiar road

meaning.en: Doing something familiar with ease.
meaning.zh: 驾着轻便的车子走熟悉的路。比喻对情况熟悉，做起来容易。

examples.zh: 这种活他干了十几年，轻车熟路。
examples.en: He's done this kind of work for over a decade — he knows the ropes.

examples.zh: 导游轻车熟路地带我们走了一条近道。
examples.en: The guide, on familiar ground, took us by a shortcut.

story.en: Han Yu praised a scholar's eloquence as being "like a team of four horses drawing a light cart along a familiar road" (若驷马驾轻车就熟路).
story.zh: 韩愈《送石处士序》："若驷马驾轻车就熟路，而王良、造父为之先后也。"

natural: Saving on clothes and cutting down on food

meaning.en: To scrimp and save; to tighten one's belt.
meaning.zh: 节省穿的，缩减吃的。形容生活节俭。

examples.zh: 父母节衣缩食供他上大学。
examples.en: His parents scrimped and saved to put him through university.

examples.zh: 为了买房，小两口节衣缩食。
examples.en: The young couple tightened their belts to buy a flat.

meaning.en: To exaggerate; to overstate.
meaning.zh: 说话或写文章言过其实。

examples.zh: 这则广告夸大其词，产品根本没那么神奇。
examples.en: The ad exaggerates — the product isn't nearly that amazing.

examples.zh: 他说自己能连跑一百公里，有点夸大其词了。
examples.en: His claim that he can run a hundred kilometres non-stop is a bit of an overstatement.

meaning.en: To make a long, arduous journey.
meaning.zh: 翻山越岭，趟水过河。形容旅途艰苦。

examples.zh: 地质队员跋山涉水，寻找矿藏。
examples.en: The geologists trekked over hill and dale searching for minerals.

examples.zh: 山里的孩子每天跋山涉水去上学。
examples.en: Children in the mountains make a long, hard journey to school every day.

natural: Catching the wind and grasping at shadows

meaning.en: To speak or act on groundless hearsay.
meaning.zh: 比喻说话做事毫无事实根据。

examples.zh: 这些传言都是捕风捉影，不可信。
examples.en: These rumours are groundless — don't believe them.

examples.zh: 新闻报道不能捕风捉影。
examples.en: News reports shouldn't be based on speculation.

story.en: The Han history mocks the emperor's search for immortals: "it is like tying up the wind and catching shadows" (如系风捕景), never to be grasped.
story.zh: 《汉书·郊祀志》："听其言，洋洋满耳，若将可遇；求之，荡荡如系风捕景，终不可得。"
